HED.prologue: testaux 1.1.0 is the deprecation version of the testaux auxiliary-items library of the hed-tests test schema set, partnered with standard schema 8.5.0 like 1.0.0. It is a copy of testaux 1.0.0 with three changes: the unit bigauxunit and the unit modifier auxMod carry deprecatedFrom=1.0.0, and the new unit auxsiunit, which has SIUnit, gives auxMod a unit to modify. It exists so the suite can test ELEMENT_DEPRECATED for a deprecated unit and a deprecated unit modifier, which no released standard schema can. Change from testaux 1.0.0: minor (elements deprecated, a unit added).

node.name: Aux-measure
node.description: A tag that takes a value with units of the auxUnits unit class.

node.name: Aux-value
node.description: A tag that takes a value of the auxClass value class.

unit.description: The base unit of the auxUnits unit class.

unit.name: bigauxunit
unit.description: A larger unit of the auxUnits unit class. Deprecated: use auxunit with a value 1000 times larger.

unit.name: auxsiunit
unit.description: An SI unit of the auxUnits unit class that takes SI unit modifiers.

unitModifierDefinition.description: The auxiliary unit modifier shared across libraries in the aux merge cases. Deprecated: write the value 100 times larger without the modifier.
